h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Morbi

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Morbi

items.pText: Morbi is the ceramic tile capital of India, and when a factory colony or school here builds a play area, the first instinct is often to finish the ground with tiles. Under playground equipment, that is the wrong choice. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 440 km from Morbi, and supplies schools, societies and industrial townships across Saurashtra.

We help you plan the surface along with the equipment. Share the site size, the age group and a few photos, and we will suggest equipment and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing. Once you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture and dispatch by road, and our team or a dealer in Gujarat installs it.

richText.heading: What should go under playground equipment

c: Tiles, granite and plain concrete are hard and slippery when wet, and a fall from a swing or slide onto them can cause serious injury. Inside the safe play area, use an impact-absorbing surface instead. We supply
that cushions falls, drains well and does not get slippery after rain.

Tiles still have a place. Use them for the walkway around the play area, for seating zones and for the paths that reach it. Morbi's summers are hot, and rubber flooring stays more comfortable than stone in the sun. Popular first pieces include

items.q: Can we use tiles under playground equipment?
items.a: Not inside the safe play area. Tiles are hard and slippery when wet. Use rubber flooring under the equipment and keep tiles for paths and seating areas around it.

items.q: Do you supply rubber flooring with the equipment?
items.a: Yes. We supply rubber flooring for play areas along with the playground equipment, and we show where it should go on the layout drawing.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Morbi?
items.a: Yes. We send it by road from Vasai and install with our team or a dealer in Gujarat, grouted or self-standing.
